name: watchkeeper
description: Guards, a spend ledger and an evidence gate for Claude Code: a lean start-up, path and secret guards, gated mail, publishing, money and purchases, a nudge back on a 'done' with no test behind it, a kill switch, a ledger of the headless runs it starts, and a steward you can schedule that paces itself on your plan's weekly limit. Optional task queue for Gemini in Antigravity. Keeps its data in local files; sends nothing to Nexodyne; no telemetry.
